title: Rectangular bar
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. This sketch should consist of a single loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0427, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.0427, 0.0) and ends at (0.0427, 0.75). The third line starts at (0.0427, 0.75) and ends at (0.0, 0.75). Finally, the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.75) and returns to the origin (0.0, 0.0). After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the same Euler angles and translating it with the same translation vector. To generate the three-dimensional model, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.0445 units. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction and that the operation results in a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar are: length of 0.04272897191389781 units, width of 0.7499999991448598 units, and height of 0.04450934574364355 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0427, 0).lineTo(0.0427, 0.75).lineTo(0, 0.75).close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = sketch.extrude(0.0445)
